title: The typecheck runs when the project has a typechecker configured and fails non-zero on any type error
asA: operator whose project uses a typechecked language
iWant: the typecheck gate to run when my project has a typechecker configured and be off when it does not
soThat: the default aligns with project shape without me writing an explicit override

acceptanceCriteria.description: When `checkSet.typecheck` is true (or the auto-detect finds a `tsconfig.json` or equivalent tool marker at the project root and the flag is unset), the gate-runner runs the project-realised typecheck runner. A non-zero exit flips the gate outcome to `failed`. The per-gate report at `.rcf/reports/ci/typecheck.json` carries `checkKind: "typecheck"`. Template values the applying agent sets: The applying agent sets the workflowShape elicits (checkSet, branchModel, releaseMode, scheduledAudit, providerHint); the AC substitutes the project's declaration for the illustrative shape values.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a project with `checkSet.typecheck: true` and a realised typecheck runner
acceptanceCriteria.when: a CI workflow invokes the gate-runner
acceptanceCriteria.then: a report file at `.rcf/reports/ci/typecheck.json` is written with `checkKind: "typecheck"`, and the gate outcome tracks the runner exit code

acceptanceCriteria.description: When `checkSet.typecheck` is unset and the project tree contains no `tsconfig.json` or equivalent tool marker, the auto-detect leaves the check off and no `typecheck.json` report file is written. Template values the applying agent sets: The applying agent sets the workflowShape elicits (checkSet, branchModel, releaseMode, scheduledAudit, providerHint); the AC substitutes the project's declaration for the illustrative shape values.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a project with `checkSet.typecheck` unset and no typechecker marker at the project root
acceptanceCriteria.when: a CI workflow invokes the gate-runner
acceptanceCriteria.then: no `typecheck` gate is included in the aggregate report and no `.rcf/reports/ci/typecheck.json` file is written

acceptanceCriteria.description: A typecheck configured on a project that has no typechecker at all skips with checkKind=typecheck and verdict=skipped (with a stable reason `no-typechecker-configured`); the aggregate treats skipped as pass for the aggregate report only when the required set does not include typecheck, else refuses pipeline pass.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a project with checkSet.typecheck true but no tsconfig or equivalent
acceptanceCriteria.then: the per-gate report writes verdict=skipped with reason=no-typechecker-configured; the aggregate refuses pass when typecheck is in the required set
